name: Ball Maze
description: A tilt-and-roll ball maze generated from a seed: a floor, maze walls and a border, with a round start marker and a star finish marker inlaid in the floor. Every seed gives a different perfect maze (one route from start to finish); the same seed always gives the same one. Square or round outline, 4 to 15 cells a side. Corridors widen automatically to fit the chosen ball bearing or BB. Optional snap-on lid, printed alongside and upside down, keeps the ball in. Three colours, four with the lid.
source: inspired by Printables Russian Doll Maze Puzzle Box (18.4k downloads) and Random Maze Generator
